title: Having no career plans before 'Bama State
summary: Hawkins was so absorbed in music he never planned ahead; at 'Bama State they made him leader.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: I know it's a long way

back when you're thinking, and it's sometimes difficult to say now, when did I first begin to think this way and that way. But, as far as you can remember before you went to 'Bama State, what kinds of ideas did you have about what you wanted to be, and what you wanted to do, and how you saw the world and how you were going to fit into it?

Well, to be truthful about it, I was so stuck with music, I didn't, I wasn't thinking that far ahead. I was, anytime somebody wanted to play, I'd go out and have a jam session, which I didn't know what a jam session was those years. We'd just play among ourselves. But, I wasn't thinking that far ahead about what I wanted to do. I just as it came along. That's what I did. Because I did not know I was gonna be a band leader.
When we get down to what caused that, when I got to 'Bama State, they made me the leader of the band. That was it. That's how that began. Then, I started writing a little bit after that.
But, until the time that you went to 'Bama State, you hadn't thought too much about any of these areas that projected so far into the future?
No, I didn't. No. I was just enjoying myself. I really loved it.
